edges: Helmut Kohl participated in the final stage of World War II as a teenage soldier and joined the Christian Democratic Union in 1947.
Helmut Kohl played a significant role in the reunification of Germany.
Helmut Kohl was involved in a scandal regarding secret funding.
Helmut Kohl was a member of the Christian Democratic Union.
Helmut Kohl surpassed Konrad Adenauer as the longest-serving Chancellor of the Federal Republic.
